title: Compiler and recipe contracts
objective: Make accepted recipe semantics survive resolution, lowering and output metadata without silent coercion.
worker_paths: internal/dataframe/compiler/*; internal/dataframe/semantic/*; internal/dataframe/spec/*; internal/dataframe/expression/*; internal/dataframe/recipe/*; conformance/compiler/*
integration_paths: internal/server/server.go; internal/server/options.go; openapi/openapi.yaml; generated/*; Makefile; ui/package.json; ui/package-lock.json; scripts/loom-dev.mjs; scripts/validate_architecture_plan.py; scripts/test_validate_architecture_plan.py
live_gate: Add literal multi-related-row, array, aggregate/filter and unsupported-operation fixtures; compare preview, published values and column losslessness.
performance_gate: Capture compiler oracle benchmem before/after; investigate >10% median time or allocation growth on unchanged cases.
migration_gate: Version recipe/provenance changes; test current and saved older recipes, reject unsupported forms explicitly; migrate all internal callers in the same wave.
rollback: Revert this WP before dependent merges. After persisted-format writes, restore the owned test snapshot or forward-fix; do not assume binary rollback is safe. Production rollback requires a separate approved runbook.
iteration_gate: For each issue, run focused compiler/recipe tests and affected callers. If accepted recipe forms, emitted values or public schemas change, exercise the affected preview/publication API on the warm isolated stack. No browser run for a purely internal refactor.
integration_gate: After the integrated wave, run the README Go/UI/boundary gates and make verify-fast on the integrated branch. Repeat at final handoff. Add make verify-full only when watcher, build or dev-driver behavior changed. Record tested commit, commands, outcomes and retained evidence.

title: Bounded catalog and ingest lifecycle
objective: Bound retained metadata and cancellation; make failed/inactive-generation retention an explicit operational policy.
live_gate: Injected ingest cancellation/failure leaves active generation unchanged; bounded cleanup exits; retained failed records remain inspectable.
performance_gate: Add adversarial many-field/long-value and multi-generation cache checks; prove configured retained-entry/byte bounds, including Merge.
migration_gate: Keep immutable failed-generation and inactive-release history; choose documented retention/rebuild policy before adding resume or deletion. No production cleanup in this WP.
rollback: Revert this WP before dependent merges. After persisted-format writes, restore the owned test snapshot or forward-fix; do not assume binary rollback is safe. Production rollback requires a separate approved runbook.
iteration_gate: For each issue, run focused catalog/ingest tests and affected callers. Use bounded-memory, cancellation or storage-backed failure checks for the specific invariant. Browser verification is deferred to integration unless the actual diff changes a frontend/API contract.
integration_gate: After the integrated wave, run the README Go/UI/boundary gates and make verify-fast on the integrated branch. Repeat at final handoff. Add make verify-full only when watcher, build or dev-driver behavior changed. Record tested commit, commands, outcomes and retained evidence.

title: Publication durability and concurrency
objective: Fence every durable checkpoint, bound cancellation/reconciliation, and remove unnecessary cross-identity serialization.
live_gate: Storage-backed delayed-owner takeover and post-insert checkpoint-failure scenarios preserve the active pointer and converge to a known row/count state.
performance_gate: Blocked I/O for bundle A does not block unrelated B; same-key starts remain serialized. Reconcile peak retained records stays within configured page bound.
migration_gate: Version identity/fence metadata if changed; test old execution documents and staged-table recovery. Fence writes before relaxing locks; never replay uncertain inserts without reconciliation.
rollback: Revert this WP before dependent merges. After persisted-format writes, restore the owned test snapshot or forward-fix; do not assume binary rollback is safe. Production rollback requires a separate approved runbook.
iteration_gate: For each issue, run focused publication tests and affected callers. Exercise changed lease, checkpoint, retry or recovery behavior with targeted concurrency/failure-injection checks and real storage where adapter semantics matter. No routine browser requirement.
integration_gate: After the integrated wave, run the README Go/UI/boundary gates and make verify-fast on the integrated branch. Repeat at final handoff. Add make verify-full only when watcher, build or dev-driver behavior changed. Record tested commit, commands, outcomes and retained evidence.

migration_gate: Keep explicit override support and existing loom-dev data untouched; stop only owned stacks. Retention policy must preserve evidence before any opt-in cleanup.
